headings.family: Geometric Sans (e.g., Plus Jakarta Sans, Manrope, or system sans-serif)

colors.strategy: Strictly utilize provided CSS variables to ensure seamless toggling between 'theme-gymaxis' (light) and 'pulse' (branded) themes.

branding_treatments.neutral_gymaxis: Apply the 'gx-grad-text' class to the Tenant Name to provide a premium, white-labeled gradient accent.
branding_treatments.pulse_branded: Apply 'text-[var(--color-brand-blue)]' to the Tenant Name for strong, brand-specific coloring.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Tactical Minimalism. Dense but clear, prioritizing information hierarchy.

ModulePageHeader.description: Unified page-header system for Operations, Memberships, CRM, Marketing, and Comms Centre.

TitleRow.ModuleIcon: Optional Lucide-react icon (size 28 or 32, strokeWidth 2). Color: text-[var(--theme-text)]
TitleRow.TenantName: text-2xl md:text-3xl font-semibold. Color treatment depends on active brand (see branding_treatments).

RightRegion.layout: flex flex-row md:flex-col items-center md:items-end justify-between md:justify-start w-full md:w-auto gap-4 md:gap-2
RightRegion.ActionSlot: Slot for module-specific controls like 'Studio Mode' toggle. Rendered right-aligned on desktop, inline or right-aligned on mobile.

naming_rules.operations_override: If the module is 'Operations', the ModuleName displayed MUST be 'Dashboard'.

instructions_to_main_agent: The component should accept props: moduleName (string), tenantName (string), subtitle (string), date (string), actionSlot (node), icon (node), and brandMode ('gymAxis' | 'pulse').
Implement the 'Operations' -> 'Dashboard' renaming logic internally within the component.
Use only the specified CSS variables for colors (no hardcoded tailwind colors except for the gradient class).
Ensure all data-testid attributes are applied according to the guidelines.
Ensure the component uses a <header> HTML5 tag as its root element.
